items.title: Introducing the Atlassian AI SDLC Index: What the data shows about AI and real work
items.summary: What is AI changing about how software teams work? That’s the question behind the new Atlassian AI SDLC Index, which brings together data from more than 340,000 engineers at over 500 engineering organizations to examine AI’s impact across the software development lifecycle. CEO and Co-Founder Mike Cannon-Brookes shares his thoughts.
